ambiguities.text: The specification is a meta-EIP that references multiple component EIPs without defining the precise interaction between them
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume each component EIP is independently specified and this meta-EIP defines the overall coordination strategy.

ambiguities.text: The term 'correctness and completeness proofs' is used without precisely defining what constitutes completeness
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume completeness means the proof demonstrates no additional matching data exists beyond what was returned.

ambiguities.text: The relationship between ZK-verified log index root (EIP-7792) and 2D log index (EIP-7745) is not clarified
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume EIP-7792 is an alternative approach to EIP-7745, with implementation choosing one or the other.

implicit_assumptions.description: Light clients have access to verified state roots (e.g., from consensus layer) to validate proofs against
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Without trusted state roots, proofs cannot be verified and the entire security model collapses.

implicit_assumptions.description: SSZ libraries will be available and production-grade across all execution clients
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Uneven SSZ implementation quality could cause consensus issues or security vulnerabilities.

implicit_assumptions.description: Backward compatibility is maintained during the transition period
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Applications relying on current RLP/JSON-RPC patterns could break during transition.

implicit_assumptions.description: Attackers cannot forge SSZ Merkle proofs without knowing the underlying data
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: The entire proof-based verification system would be compromised.
